name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 6px solid focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow or animation. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for keyboard users while keeping the interface clean and predictable. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence for users who rely on focus indicators, but the higher contrast and thicker ring compensate.

name: Reader
text: A 6px ring at 7:1 contrast still risks disappearing on patterned or dark backgrounds—users with low vision or cognitive load may miss it. A 3px ring at 9:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow (subtle, no animation) would stay visible everywhere without sacrificing WCAG 2.2 AA. Test with real screen-reader users on varied backgrounds to settle it.
